executionPolicy: one stage per reviewed task; no push/merge/deploy

stages.title: Refresh the baseline and adopt the extension deliberately
stages.goal: Establish what HEAD actually contains, reconcile the existing MG work, and define a safe boundary for the new city-experience implementation.

stages.title: Make content semantics and publication rules explicit
stages.goal: Provide the reviewed data structures that make the intended interactions truthful without losing the existing collection.

stages.title: Unify selection, filters, history and session state
stages.goal: Make every lens answer the same visitor question while preserving context, deep links and reset behavior.

stages.title: Create the signature collection-regrouping interaction
stages.goal: Let the collection visibly reorganize around communities and contributions without losing identity, readability or touch access.

stages.title: Turn a selected person into a sourced, layered encounter
stages.goal: Provide What changed?, evidence and approved gallery browsing without rewriting historical sources or depending on pending films.

stages.title: Make Cleveland places a real entry into the collection
stages.goal: Connect city/neighborhood/place exploration to people and their specific documented activities.

stages.title: Explain relationships and place two lives in dialogue
stages.goal: Extend existing connection mechanics into evidence-backed mixed-entity exploration and noncompetitive comparison.

stages.title: Add historical time without confusing it with induction
stages.goal: Let visitors explore when documented civic activity occurred while retaining the current complete induction chronology.

stages.title: Complete the walk-up invitation and public continuation
stages.goal: Make the new system approachable without prior name knowledge and preserve useful discoveries beyond the screen.

stages.title: Review access, installed-display interaction and measured performance
stages.goal: Make the new capabilities usable through touch, keyboard and independent accessible paths while keeping the exhibit responsive.

stages.title: Make offline operation a versioned, recoverable package
stages.goal: Replace reliance on opportunistic browsing caches with deliberate provisioning, coherent updates and tested recovery.

stages.title: Gate the exact release artifact and hand it to staff
stages.goal: Ensure that the artifact deployed or installed is the one validated, with explicit content, access and operational responsibilities.
